findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Inspector observed an accumulation of food and various debris on the top of the dish machine and the lids of the soft serve ice cream containers. Discussed with the person in charge (PIC). Ensure nonfood contact surfaces are cleaned at a frequency to prevent the contamination of ready to eat foods or food contact surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: FIRST REPEAT: Inspector observed the floors below the fryers on the dry storage side of the restaurant to contain a significant build up of grease and food debris. Discussed increasing the frequency at which this space is cleaned. Ensure that spaces under the fryers are free of the accumulation of grease and food debris to prevent the harborage of pests. Physical characteristics must be smooth and easily cleanable.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.[C]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A)  Inspector observed an accumulation of soil inside the nozzles of the self-serving soda machines in the lobby. PIC was made aware. One of the machines was cleaned and sanitized. The other soda machine will have out of order posted on them until the nozzles are cleaned to sight of touch. Ensure that the internal surface of the soda machine nozzles are monitored and cleaned thoroughly to prevent contamination.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Inspector observed hand washing occur and faucets turned off without the benefit of a clean barrier to prevent the recontamination of clean hands. Hand washing was instantly coached and employees rewashed hands properly. The violation is considered corrected on site. 

2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Inspector observed cheese at 50F in the reach in cooler under the prep line. The cheese slices (approximately 180) were discarded in the garbage. The facility has discontinued the use of this cold holding unit and will have it repaired. There is plenty of storage for cheese without the use of this cooler. Store foods requiring cold holding properly at 41F or below. 

3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
Inspector observed ants at the prep area near tea and at the hand sink next to fry station. The pest control company has been called and will be here tomorrow. The log from the last routine inspection in February did not show any ants or other pests.

6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Inspector observed the following items to have soil build up. 1) edge of dish machine where it attaches to 3 part sink 2) cabinet under soda fountain 3) bottoms of some cold holding units especially #15. 
Clean and maintain clean for the next routine inspection. 

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.
